name: dadbox-server
description: Scripts only. The function runs on Deno at Supabase; nothing is installed here — this repo lives in a synced folder, so tools come through npx and keep their caches outside it.

scripts.check: cd supabase/functions/api && DENO_DIR=$HOME/.cache/deno-dadbox npx --yes deno@2 check --no-lock index.ts && DENO_DIR=$HOME/.cache/deno-dadbox npx --yes deno@2 lint
